inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the 2009 agreement is another reminder that students and families pay the price when union leaders and government officials put their contest for leverage ahead of education. The government should meet its obligations, but it must not allow threats of an indefinite nationwide strike to undermine the authority of schools or hold families hostage. Public education is a duty, not a bargaining chip; those entrusted with it should show restraint and put students’ futures and social stability first.
